Not 'checked less strictly' — not checked. Found in Loop 12 R-010: cutting `enableHeuristicRatings` left the flag named in six places across four test files and `npx tsc --noEmit` exited 0. The referrers surfaced only at runtime, when assertions happened to trip on them. This reframes '603 tests passing': the suite proves behaviour, and nothing proves the tests' own types. A type error in a test is invisible unless a runtime assertion happens to catch it. Fix is a tsconfig that includes tests (or a second one for typecheck only); the risk is that it surfaces a backlog of existing test type errors, which is the point.
